Getting Started

This starter document exercises the full docs pipeline, including the docs sidebar layout.

What's Included

  • A homepage rendered from Rust
  • A blog index with one starter article
  • A docs section at /docs/getting-started
  • Shared site assets and custom JavaScript hooks
  • A Cloudflare build script

Next Steps

Add more pages under content/docs/ and group them in src/docs_summary.rs to populate the sidebar.
